children: GigaDevice, a leading semiconductor company specializing in
, and analog products, will showcase its latest embedded technologies at Embedded World North America 2026, taking place September 22–24 at the Anaheim Convention Center. At
Booth #6428

, GigaDevice will highlight solutions spanning motor control, edge AI, embedded GUI, connectivity, and digital power, addressing the growing demand for more efficient, responsive, and intelligent embedded systems.

"As intelligence moves closer to the edge, embedded systems need to do more than process data. They need to sense, decide, and act in real time. That is what Intelligence at the Edge is all about. By combining high-performance MCUs, connectivity, and a growing partner ecosystem, GigaDevice is helping developers build smarter products across industry, infrastructure, and everyday life."
said Shahram Mehraban, Vice President and General Manager of GigaDevice Americas.
Smarter Motion Control, from Industry to Everyday Life
Motor control is at the heart of a growing range of electrified systems, where developers must balance precise performance, efficiency, reliability, and system cost.
The GD32H7 Embodied AI Robotics demo

showcases the GD32H7’s 600 MHz Cortex-M7 performance and hardware accelerators powering real-time vision, SLAM, sensor fusion and AI inference for advanced robotic perception and control. Combined with GD32F505-based joint control and multimodal sensing, the platform demonstrates low-latency, responsive human-robot interaction and accelerates embodied-AI development from simulation to real-world deployment.
The GD32F503 FOC demonstration

showcases a flexible motor-control platform for applications requiring responsive and reliable operation. Support for multiple current-sensing methods, HALL sensors and incremental encoders, together with integrated protection and monitoring functions, provides developers with flexibility across different motor-control architectures while simplifying evaluation and development.
For home appliances, the
Home Inverter Air Conditioner Solution

addresses the demand for higher efficiency, smoother operation, and cost-effective system design. The solution combines advanced compressor and fan control with harmonic and torque-ripple suppression, high-efficiency power factor correction, and comprehensive protection, helping developers optimize both system performance and hardware complexity.
Elevate Embedded Experiences with Next-Generation HMI & Graphics

GigaDevice showcases a comprehensive portfolio of high-performance embedded GUI solutions designed to enable rich, responsive and intuitive user experiences across a wide range of applications. The demos include the
GD32H7: High-Performance LVGL HMI & Graphics Platform
, demonstrating smooth, feature-rich graphics and interactive HMI capabilities;
GD32H7x & Qt: Enabling Next-Generation Embedded HMI
, highlighting the powerful combination of GD32H7x high-performance MCUs and
Qt for MCUs
for advanced graphical applications; and an
emWin-Based GUI Solution

, showcasing efficient and flexible embedded graphics development, with an all-in-one development toolset available for free commercial use. Together, these solutions demonstrate GigaDevice’s commitment to delivering scalable MCU platforms and software ecosystems for next-generation embedded HMI and graphics applications.
Bringing Intelligence, Interaction, and Connectivity to the Edge

Edge intelligence is also transforming how embedded devices perceive and interact with their surroundings. Built around the 600MHz GD32H7 high-performance MCU series, GigaDevice will demonstrate an AI face-recognition application that brings machine learning directly to the device. Using an optimized, fully integer-quantized model, the solution achieves 97.9% mAP with a single inference time of 77ms on the GD32H759 development board, demonstrating the potential of MCU-based AI for smart home, intelligent security, and access-control applications.
Complementing on-device intelligence,
GigaDevice’s GD32VW553-based wireless modules

make it easier for developers to add high-performance wireless connectivity to their products. Combining Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE 5.2) in a compact module, the platform is designed for flexible deployment across consumer, industrial, and IoT applications. For customers migrating from established Wi-Fi module platforms, selected GD32VW553-based modules offer pin-compatible footprints, helping minimize redesign effort and providing a straightforward upgrade path to Wi-Fi 6 and BLE 5.2.
Enabling More Intelligent Power Systems

GigaDevice will also highlight its digital power technologies, extending intelligence into power management and energy-related applications. These solutions demonstrate GigaDevice’s broader commitment to helping developers improve efficiency, reliability, and system-level performance as electrification continues to reshape industry and infrastructure.
Meet GigaDevice at Booth #6428
Visitors are invited to Booth #6428 to experience the demonstrations and discuss application requirements with GigaDevice experts. GigaDevice will also participate in an Exhibitor Forum:
Speaker

Intelligence at the Edge – Driving Innovation Across Industry, Infrastructure, and Everyday Life

September 22 at 2:30 p.m.

GigaDevice’s expanding portfolio of high-performance and application-specific MCUs, together with its semiconductor technologies and development ecosystem, provides developers with the foundation to bring intelligent, connected edge applications to market.
